project_type: TensorFlow 2.10 groupwise 3D brain MRI registration research code (single repo, no package build); training entry main.py, model code models/, training runtime runtime/, DALI loading data_loading/, SLURM scripts slurm/, GPU tools tests/gpu/
language: Python (must be Python 3.8 syntax for the cluster container tf10_nv.sif: py3.8.10, TF 2.10, DALI 1.18, numpy 1.21, scipy 1.4); bash for slurm/ and runner scripts
build_system: None (plain Python). 'Build' = py_compile + ast.parse(feature_version=(3,8)) in WSL conda env bgr_preproc38 and bash -n on shell scripts (stage 1 of tests/run_tests_wsl.sh).
test_framework: unittest (python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v) in WSL conda env tf_gpu (TF 2.10, py3.9, GTX 1080). Every TF test module imports tests.tf_setup FIRST (TF32 off, 6000 MB GPU limit). TF-free tests must not import tensorflow. tests/gpu/ is not part of discovery (tools loaded via importlib in tests).
build_command: Syntax: in bgr_preproc38: python -m py_compile <files> plus the ast feature_version=(3,8) loop from tests/run_tests_wsl.sh stage 1; bash -n <script>.
test_command: Full suite (background, timeout >= 4 h, ~3.5 h, baseline 381 OK + 4 skips): wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh . Targeted: python -m unittest tests.<module> -v in tf_gpu with the stage-2 exports of run_tests_wsl.sh (TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3, TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512, BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000, TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0).
verification_instructions: 1) PowerShell 5.1 mangles quotes: write every multi-line/quoted command into d:\Research\Brain_Registration_Projects\brain-group-rad\.agents\tmp\<name>.sh and run: wsl -d Ubuntu bash -c "tr -d '\r' < /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.agents/tmp/<name>.sh | bash -s" ; inside: source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh; set +u; conda activate tf_gpu (or bgr_preproc38); cd /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad; export the stage-2 env vars; delete the script afterwards. 2) After each change run the targeted tests named in the FEAT verification. 3) Always re-run the goldens: python -m unittest tests.test_trainer.TestLinearOnlyUnchanged tests.test_trainer.TestDeformUnchanged -v and confirm stderr prints '[golden] max |diff| 0' and '[golden deform] max |diff| 0'. 4) py_compile + ast (3,8) in bgr_preproc38 on every new/changed .py; bash -n on every new/changed .sh. 5) The full suite is run once at the end (FEAT-004) and by the loop fixer if code changed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: models/memory_coefficients.json is generated by `python scripts/memory_model.py fit` (re-run after any change to models/memory_calibration.json or the inventory). .agents/tasks/milestone-9/memory_holdout.json, integration_steps.json, grid.json, recommendation.json are local measurement outputs (kept). NEVER regenerate tests/fixtures/m7_linear_golden.json or tests/fixtures/lncc_deform_golden.json (never set BGR_WRITE_GOLDEN=1).
environment_constraints: HARD: no git commit, no push, no cluster access (no ssh/sbatch/git pull/scancel). Local GPU = WSL GTX 1080, TF memory limit 6000 MB MAX, never higher (--gpu-memory-limit-mb 6000 / BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000), TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0. TF32 off: models.precision.configure_tf_precision() first in every GPU entry point. tf_gpu env crashes if the GPU is hidden (do not set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''). Neither local env has nvidia.dali (DALI tests skip). The repo's scratch/ folder is NOT git-ignored: local outputs go to .agents/tasks/milestone-9/ via explicit --out. .agents/tmp/ is git-ignored (scratch scripts there, delete after use). Windows host; edit files with the file tools (LF endings for .sh files).
contribution_requirements: Every new knob OFF by default; with defaults levels 4 and 2 are bit-identical: both goldens (tests/test_trainer.py TestLinearOnlyUnchanged -> tests/fixtures/m7_linear_golden.json, TestDeformUnchanged -> tests/fixtures/lncc_deform_golden.json) at max |diff| 0. New paths are Python trace-time switches; defaults create no new op. No new ModelConfig fields (old config.json restore unchanged; runtime.checkpoint.check_cascade_config accepts today's level-4 -> level-2 pair). Python 3.8 syntax only (no PEP 585/604 runtime annotations, no 3.9+ stdlib), numpy 1.21 / scipy 1.4 APIs only. Implement the approved design .agents/tasks/milestone-9/design-m9-phase1.md v5 faithfully; apply the plan's NIT notes N1-N5. R5 (3-level cascade, level-1 DALI training, level-1 validation, retraining) is design-only: do NOT implement; --cascade-from stays level-2-only. Match repo style: module docstrings with design references, argparse parser.error naming the option, unittest classes, tests.runtime_helpers NARROW/TINY widths.
key_patterns: Trace-time Python switches (e.g. GroupRegLevelModel.gradient_checkpointing attribute, BatchNormWithSeparateAffine.stats_frozen, set_bn_stats_frozen setter pattern in models/layers.py). Decoder recompute today: tf.recompute_grad(run_decoder)(*skips) guarded by decoder.built in models/group_net.py _call_deform. Shared sampler models/layers.sample_voxel_coords (linear branch: x->y->z corner loop, int32 lo_i/base, out/wsum accumulated left to right). diffeo.warp/warp_field/compose/integrate_svf/exp_and_inverse/pairwise_displacement/compose_cascade chain. Trainer._make_deform_step in runtime/run.py (tape, losses.deform_loss(out, batch, lam_p, lam_s, order, **ncc_kw), static None-grad filter, BN backup/restore on non-finite). Trainer._bn_layers staticmethod (to move to layers.batch_norm_layers). Cascade: models/cascade.py FrozenStage, PREV_LEVEL={2: 4}, FROZEN_LEVEL bound at import, _float32_policy(). Measurement tool tests/gpu/measure_level_memory.py: measure() builds model with build_model(n) (the R1.3 bug), KEY_FIELDS/config_key merge, writes once at the end (to become per-config atomic). Golden helpers: tests/test_cascade.py _GrapplerOff, tests/test_trainer.py _OpDeterminism. Stub SLURM tests: tests/test_slurm_scripts.py (stub singularity/nvidia-smi/git on PATH, env overrides PROJ/REPO/SCRATCH_ROOT...).
directory_structure: models/ (TF model: layers.py sampler + group blocks, group_net.py encoder/decoders/GroupRegLevelModel, diffeo.py fields/SVF, cascade.py FrozenStage, config.py ModelConfig dataclass TF-free, precision.py); runtime/ (args.py TF-free argparse, run.py Trainer/TrainConfig, losses.py, checkpoint.py, fixed_data.py synthetic groups); data_loading/ (params.py LEVEL_SHAPE {4:(40,56,48),2:(80,112,96),1:(160,224,192)}, DALI loader); main.py (training entry); scripts/ (helper CLIs; new memory_model.py, step_times_from_metrics.py); slurm/ (sbatch scripts, m8_memory.sh template); tests/ (unittest modules, fixtures/ goldens, gpu/ GPU tools not in discovery, run_tests_wsl.sh runner); .agents/tasks/milestone-9/ (requirements, design, review, plan, FEAT artifacts, report + local measurement JSONs).
